issue_context.title: kubeadm: ignored certificate-authority option in discovery file
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:
`kubeadm join` with discovery file containing `certificate-authority` option pointed to a file with CA certificate (instead of default `certificate-authority-data`) fails.

**What you expected to happen**:
`kubeadm join` with discovery file containing `certificate-authority` option pointed to a file with CA certificate successfully load the certificate from the file and use it.

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:
For a discovery file
* extract CA certificate from `certificate-authority-data` into an external file
* remove `certificate-authority-data`
* add `certificate-authority` pointing to the external file

**Anything else we need to know?**:
nope
